required_next_actions: Review ready_for_watchlist_insert candidates and convert only sponsor or official-source records into curated watchlist entries.
Run strict eligibility gating after watchlist insertion; harvesting never creates application-ready status by itself.
guardrails: Harvesting creates candidate source leads, not applicant eligibility.
Official, sponsor, professional-body, and law-firm source pages are preferred over aggregators.
Aggregator results may discover leads but cannot prove current eligibility.
No harvested candidate source becomes application-ready until the source is verified and strict eligibility gating runs downstream.
Do not store private FAFSA, tax, SSN, income, or full personal-statement material in the public repository.
